Career Center

Build a Career at Dejavoo.

Many companies can offer you a job. At Dejavoo, we offer the opportunity to build a lasting career.

As an innovative leader in payment technology, Dejavoo provides talented, passionate, and goal-oriented professionals with meaningful opportunities to grow in a fast-moving industry. Whether you are launching your career, advancing into senior leadership, or exploring your next executive opportunity, Dejavoo offers an environment where your work can make an impact.

Dejavoo is an internationally recognized payment service provider headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico, with operations across the United States, Canada, Israel, Armenia, and India. Over the past twenty years, we have built a strong presence in communities nationwide through Independent Sales Offices (ISOs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), sales agents, and point-of-sale (POS) equipment dealers.

Why Dejavoo?

At Dejavoo, you’ll find more than competitive compensation. You’ll join a collaborative workplace where experienced senior managers are recognized as experts in their fields and where employees are supported in building long-term success.

We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Excellent benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement
  • The change to work alongside experienced senior leaders
  • A collaborative and momentum-driven work environment

To learn more, contact us today.

Career paths at Dejavoo are diverse, reflecting the breadth of our business and the evolution of the payments industry.
Opportunities may be available across a range of departments, including:

Our Values

What began as a family business has grown into a proud, agile organization with a unique proposition: combining leading technology with strong human relationships. That balance continues to shape how we work, grow, and serve our partners.

Our core values are the foundation of everything we do:

  • Integrity
  • Innovation
  • Teamwork
  • Partnership
  • Accountability

These values are reflected in our distinctive support approach. Whether our partners or their merchants need sales, technical, or marketing support, Dejavoo is committed to delivering service that stands out across the industry.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dejavoo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
